title: Save a cart for later
summary: As a signed-in shopper I want to save my cart so I can finish buying on another device.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in shopper can save the cart with one button
The saved cart loads when the shopper signs in on another device
Guests are asked to sign in before saving

title: Removing an item leaves it in the total
summary: There is no way to remove an item, and the total includes items the shopper no longer wants.
reproSteps: 1. Add two items. 2. Try to remove one. 3. The total still includes it.
acceptanceCriteria: An item can be removed from the cart
The total updates when an item is removed

title: Discount codes spec
summary: Shoppers can enter one discount code at checkout.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid codes show an error and leave the total unchanged
A code can only take off up to 50%
Codes are checked on the server
